name: Zeiss 1/18 homogeneous-immersion objective, former series
summary: Zeiss sold a very high-power 1/18-inch oil-immersion microscope objective of its older achromatic series, listed in 1885 and dropped from its catalogue by 1889.
description: Carl Zeiss Jena old achromatic 1/18 designated homogeneous-immersion objective, catalogue no. 46 in 1885; 1.25 mm equivalent focal length, fixed or correction mount.
tier_reason: A particular catalogue objective is a fine-detail witness; the catalogue does not make it all homogeneous immersion. This is a scoped consequence judgement, not a reward for documentation or representation.

impact.note: One catalogue lens of an older series, soon withdrawn; a variant of existing objectives on which nothing later is known to rest.

market.note: The 1885 catalogue priced the exact old-series objective and describes stock.

evidence.supports: The 1/18 homogeneous-immersion objective was a priced offering stocked in fixed mounts; it had a recently improved working distance.

date.basis: Dated manufacturer catalogue describes prices and stock, but not its earliest offer.

events.statement: Zeiss listed the 1/18 homogeneous-immersion objective at 400 marks without a correction mount and described the series as stocked in fixed mounts.
events.scope: 1/18 homogeneous-immersion objective; fixed mount in stock; correction mount on request
events.caveats: This is an observed priced offering, not proof of the first-ever offer. Corrected-mount price was 450 marks and made on request.

evidence.supports: The 1/18 homogeneous-immersion objective was a priced offering stocked in fixed mounts; it had a recently improved working distance.

date.label: Between the 1885 and 1889 catalogues
date.basis: The first catalogue still offers the part; the later one says it is no longer supplied.

events.statement: By its 1889 catalogue, Zeiss said it no longer supplied the former 1/18 homogeneous-immersion objective.
events.caveats: Exact withdrawal date is not given. Does not establish the end of existing owners use, other firms products, or all achromatic objectives.

evidence.supports: The 1/18 homogeneous-immersion objective was a priced offering stocked in fixed mounts; it had a recently improved working distance.
Manufacturer states the former 1/18 homogeneous-immersion objective is no longer supplied.

earliest_record.rationale: Earliest defensible dated record of this scoped referent in the retained evidence; later community entry is recorded separately. Dated manufacturer catalogue describes prices and stock, but not its earliest offer. This is an observed priced offering, not proof of the first-ever offer. Corrected-mount price was 450 marks and made on request. This is the earliest supported record currently established here, not certification of absolute priority.

community_entry.community: Customers of Zeiss’s listed microscope-objective catalogue
community_entry.rationale: The 1885 catalogue prices and states stock for the exact old achromatic 1/18 homogeneous-immersion objective.
community_entry.caveats: A listed stocked offer does not establish the earliest possible offer or sale, nor actual end of use after its withdrawal.

caveats: No asserted first-availability year: the 1885 catalogue says the model had previously been introduced. The supplier withdrawal was by 1889, not a demonstrated end of use.

unresolved.note: The catalogue says homogeneous-immersion objectives as a class were first constructed at the factory in spring 1878, but does not date this exact 1/18 model to that year.

evidence.supports: The 1/18 homogeneous-immersion objective was a priced offering stocked in fixed mounts; it had a recently improved working distance.

unresolved.note: The 1885 priced offer is documented, but the catalogue says the objective had already been introduced; the first commercial date is unresolved.
